meta.prompt: Plan two days in Kyoto as an inline itinerary. Day 1 (Higashiyama and Gion): 08:00 Fushimi Inari Shrine ("Walk the first loop of torii gates before the crowds"; JR Nara Line then bus 206, 25 min to the next), 11:30 lunch at Nishiki Market, 14:00 Kiyomizu-dera, 18:00 Gion stroll and dinner. Day 2 (Arashiyama and the north): 08:30 Bamboo Grove, 10:00 Tenryu-ji garden, 13:00 lunch then Kinkaku-ji, 17:30 Pontocho Alley dinner. Each stop expands for details when tapped. Each day has a checklist of three things to book that I can tick off (day 1: Dinner reservation in Gion, Kiyomizu-dera evening tickets, Tea ceremony in Higashiyama; day 2: Pontocho dinner table, Sagano scenic train seats, Rickshaw ride in Arashiyama), and a line at the top that reads "N of 6 bookings left to make" and counts down as I tick.
meta.text:
ChatCard "Kyoto in two days" "Higashiyama, Gion, Arashiyama" icon:"map_rounded" status:"Plan"
  state b1=[]
  state b2=[]
  let left = 6 - length(b1) - length(b2)
  Text.strong "{left} of 6 bookings left to make"
  DayHeader "Day 1" "Higashiyama and Gion" kind:"temple" tone:"dawn" tag:"Day 1"
    ItineraryStop "Fushimi Inari Shrine" "Walk the first loop of torii gates before the crowds" time:"08:00" travel:"JR Nara Line, then bus 206, 25 min"
    ItineraryStop "Lunch at Nishiki Market" "Street snacks and pickles" time:"11:30" travel:"Walk, 10 min"
    ItineraryStop "Kiyomizu-dera" "The wooden stage over the valley" time:"14:00" travel:"Walk, 20 min"
    ItineraryStop "Gion stroll and dinner" "Lanterns on Hanamikoji, then dinner" time:"18:00" last:true
  SectionLabel "Bookings for day 1" "{length(b1)} of 3 ticked"
  Checklist "Day 1 bookings" =b1 items:["Dinner reservation in Gion","Kiyomizu-dera evening tickets","Tea ceremony in Higashiyama"]
  DayHeader "Day 2" "Arashiyama and the north" kind:"bamboo" tone:"day" tag:"Day 2"
    ItineraryStop "Bamboo Grove" "Go early, the lane is quiet" time:"08:30" travel:"Walk, 15 min"
    ItineraryStop "Tenryu-ji garden" "Pond garden under the mountain" time:"10:00" travel:"Walk, 25 min"
    ItineraryStop "Lunch, then Kinkaku-ji" "Golden pavilion over the pond" time:"13:00" travel:"Bus, 30 min"
    ItineraryStop "Pontocho Alley dinner" "Riverside dining by the Kamo" time:"17:30" last:true
  SectionLabel "Bookings for day 2" "{length(b2)} of 3 ticked"
  Checklist "Day 2 bookings" =b2 items:["Pontocho dinner table","Sagano scenic train seats","Rickshaw ride in Arashiyama"]
